investigation_target: Review Event Spam Root Cause Analysis
sprint: VIGIL AI Core Logic Verification & Optimization Sprint

root_causes.name: Frame-Accumulated Pattern Re-Ingestion
root_causes.mechanism: The demo runner was passing the growing list of all historical patterns accumulated across the entire session to `risk_tracker.update_seat()` on every frame. Without pattern ID tracking, the risk tracker treated every historical pattern as a new event on every frame, causing risk scores to instantly pin to 100.
root_causes.fix: Added `new_patterns` filtering per frame and `processed_pattern_ids: set[str]` deduplication in `SeatRiskProfile`.

root_causes.name: Rapid Cooldown Oscillation & Aggressive Recidivism
root_causes.mechanism: After an event fired, a 5-second cooldown was triggered. Upon cooldown expiry, if the student remained in the same sustained posture, the recidivism bonus (+10 pts) immediately reactivated and forced another FLAGGED_FOR_REVIEW event every 5.0 seconds.
root_causes.fix: Integrated an Incident Aggregator with a 15.0-second merge window. Repeated patterns during an ongoing incident update the existing incident's occurrence count and peak risk score rather than generating duplicate event cards.

root_causes.name: Duplicate Per-Seat Sequential 6DRepNet Inferences
root_causes.mechanism: ObservationExtractor was calling `head_pose_provider.estimate(head_crop)` for every student on every frame individually, causing 12.76 separate GPU forward passes per frame (over 1,200 forwards per 100 frames), degrading throughput to ~7.5 FPS.
root_causes.fix: Implemented scheduled 5 Hz batched tensor inference (`estimate_batch`) in `demo/runner.py` for all occupied seats simultaneously, reducing model forwards by 95.8% and boosting FPS to ~25-31 FPS.

root_causes.name: Single-Frame Keypoint Flutter & Head Jitter
root_causes.mechanism: Single-frame YOLO-Pose jitter caused temporary yaw spikes exceeding 22 degrees for 1 frame, creating short false candidate episodes.
root_causes.fix: Implemented a 3-sample median smoothing filter on relative yaw/pitch/torso angles in `TemporalEpisodeEngine` with stale observation reset (> 1500 ms gap).
